scene: Overnight planetarium projectionist aligning a brass star projector
independence: No sibling artifacts or prior project prompt data read; baseline frozen before local runtime contracts.
keyword_origin: Coordinator experimental lane; independently interpreted, not represented as user definitions.
strict_policy: All components must be visible together in one saved image; partial and unclear fail. Prompt audit pass does not establish pixel success.

initial_pixel_tests.pass_if: Two distinguishable colored illuminations arrive from opposite sides and affect the same face or blouse with a visible transition; a two-colored background alone fails.
A narrow magenta illuminated contour follows connected outer hair and shoulder; a general magenta fill or isolated neon background edge fails.
Broad emerald illumination visibly covers the curved wall behind the subject, independently of the colored subject and rim lights; a painted green object or tiny light source alone fails.
Visible facial configuration and long dark wavy hair remain recognizably similar to the attached reference under changed light; this is appearance comparison, not identity verification.
One right hand visibly turns a reachable console focus knob while left palm rests on console; connected arms are assessable.

focal_coverage.background_wash_status: Baseline-authored supplemental pixel check only; no new-data adoption or promoted visual gate.
focal_coverage.root_instruction: Preserve v1 and v2; do not force missing data or change core. Render supported composed prompt once and report gap.
